name: courseforge
description: CourseForge: remediate, restyle, build, and move Canvas courses. Bring an existing course to ADA/Ally accessibility with little manual oversight (HTML pages/assignments/discussions/quizzes/syllabus plus PowerPoint decks); restyle a course into a branded template; generate and place pages, syllabi, assignments, discussions, quizzes and exams; export/import/clone whole courses (.imscc backups and Canvas-to-Canvas copies for replica sandboxes); and optionally seed a new course from a Notion export. Weekly modules, weighted grading, nav trim, auto due dates. Idempotent and dry-run-first on writes. Content-first and does not read student data in normal use; includes one opt-in, best-effort blind-grading flow that keeps identities local.
